full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red alert for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall over Gujarat for the day. IMD also issued an orange colour warning for very heavy rainfall over Madhya Maharashtra, Saurashtra, Kutch, Telangana, Vidarbha and Madhya Pradesh today.
Heavy rainfall is also expected over Delhi, Haryana, Chandigarh, Punjab, East Rajasthan, and Sub-Himalayan West Bengal till tomorrow. According to the Weather Agency, these conditions are likely to prevail over North Eastern states including Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, and Sikkim during the next two days.
The Met Department said that thunderstorm and lightning conditions will continue over Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Marathwada, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Bihar, Jharkhand, and Odisha till tomorrow. Similar weather conditions are expected over Uttarakhand, Telangana, Kerala, Mahe, Andaman and Nicobar Islands during the next two days.
